title: Aromatic Savory Chinese Pork Braise
description: This dish features tender pork belly braised in a rich and creamy sauce, infused with the distinctive flavor of rapeseed oil and the subtle sweetness of Chinese angelica, making for a truly show-stopping Chinese culinary experience that is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and slightly caramelized.
Add the pork belly pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic-infused oil, Chinese angelica, and star anise, stirring to combine.
Pour in the soy sauce and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the coconut cream and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Season the braise to taste, then garnish with chopped scallions.
Serve the braise hot, over steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
